elements.text:
AWS Budget is a service that provides the ability to set up budgets to send
alerts when costs exceed the budget allowance (or are forecasted to exceed the
budget).
elements.rawText: AWS Budget is a service that provides the ability to set up budgets to send alerts when costs exceed the budget allowance (or are forecasted to exceed the budget).
elements.originalText: AWS Budget is a service that provides the ability to set up budgets to send alerts when costs exceed the budget allowance (or are forecasted to exceed the budget).

elements.text: AWS Budget includes 4 types of budgets:
elements.rawText: AWS Budget includes 4 types of budgets:
elements.originalText: AWS Budget includes 4 types of budgets:

elements.text: Cost Budget allows you to send alerts when total costs exceed the cost threshold in the budget.
elements.rawText: Cost Budget allows you to send alerts when total costs exceed the cost threshold in the budget.
elements.originalText: Cost Budget allows you to send alerts when total costs exceed the cost threshold in the budget.

elements.text: Usage Budget allows you to send alerts when total usage by service you select exceeds the usage threshold in the budget.
elements.rawText: Usage Budget allows you to send alerts when total usage by service you select exceeds the usage threshold in the budget.
elements.originalText: Usage Budget allows you to send alerts when total usage by service you select exceeds the usage threshold in the budget.

elements.text: RI Budget allows you to send alerts based on the usage of your prepaid services (reserved instances).
elements.rawText: RI Budget allows you to send alerts based on the usage of your prepaid services (reserved instances).
elements.originalText: RI Budget allows you to send alerts based on the usage of your prepaid services (reserved instances).

elements.text: Savings Plans Budget allows you to send alerts based on the usage of services specified in savings plans.
elements.rawText: Savings Plans Budget allows you to send alerts based on the usage of services specified in savings plans.
elements.originalText: Savings Plans Budget allows you to send alerts based on the usage of services specified in savings plans.
